Scale: the square plate looks like a dinner plate of about 24 cm across, which is roughly 345 px in the image. That gives about 0.07 cm per px, or 14 px per cm.

Scrambled eggs cover an area of roughly 150 x 130 px, or about 11 x 9 cm. With an irregular shape this is around 70 cm², and a height of about 2 cm gives roughly 140 cm³. Fluffy eggs are loose, so I take about 0.6 g/cm³, which comes to roughly 85 g. Allowing for the pile being denser than that, I settle on about 100 g.

Bacon appears as 2-3 strips, each about 13 cm long. They look cooked and glazed, perhaps with a maple or brown-sugar coating. Cooked bacon weighs about 4 g per strip when thin, or about 8 g when thick. These look moderately thick, so 3 strips at about 7 g each gives roughly 20 g.
